data.name: CannotLoadFormat
data.comment: {0} = XAML element type, {1} = resource key, {2} = error message

data.name: OptionsLanguageDescription
data.value: Language of the texts in the preview. Automatic uses the language of Visual Studio.

data.comment: Legacy Options dialog: category name (product name, normally not translated)

data.name: OptionsRootDescription
data.value: Shows a preview of XAML resources when you hover over StaticResource or DynamicResource.

data.name: OptionsMaxDefinitionsDescription
data.value: How many other definitions of the same key are listed below the preview. 0 hides the list.

data.name: OptionsTileSizeDescription
data.value: Width and height of a preview tile, between 16 and 256.

data.name: OptionsForegroundDescription
data.value: Color for a Geometry, which has no color of its own. A color name or #RRGGBB.

data.name: OptionsBackgroundDescription
data.value: Background color of the tile. A color name or #RRGGBB.

data.name: StyleTriggersFormat
data.comment: {0} = number of triggers, {1} = comma separated property names

data.name: CornerRadiusFormat
data.value: Top left {0} · Top right {1} · Bottom right {2} · Bottom left {3}
data.comment: {0}..{3} = top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left

data.name: FontNotInstalledFormat
data.value: {0} is not installed on this computer. The sample uses a fallback font.

data.name: FontFileNotFoundFormat
data.value: {0} was not found in {1}. The sample uses a fallback font.
data.comment: {0} = font family name, {1} = folder or file

data.name: SampleText
data.comment: Text shown inside the live sample control

data.name: SampleDisabled
data.comment: Label under the sample with IsEnabled=False

data.name: NoLiveSampleOwnTypeFormat
data.value: No live sample: {0} is not a WPF type, so Visual Studio can't load it.
data.comment: {0} = type name with prefix, e.g. local:FancyControl

data.name: NoPreviewOwnTypeFormat
data.value: No preview: {0} is not a WPF type, so Visual Studio can't load it.
data.comment: {0} = type name with prefix, e.g. local:Book

data.name: OptionsLiveSampleDescription
data.value: Shows a real control with the style or ControlTemplate applied. A second, disabled sample appears when the style reacts to IsEnabled.

data.name: GoToMoreDefinitionsFormat
data.value: {0}: {1} more definition(s). Hover over the reference to see them.
data.comment: {0} = resource key, {1} = number of other definitions

data.name: OverriddenByFormat
data.comment: {0} = file name of the definition WPF uses

data.name: NotMergedFileFormat
data.value: {0} is not in any MergedDictionaries. WPF only loads it if code adds it.

data.name: OverriddenKeyWarningFormat
data.value: Resource '{0}' is overridden by the definition in {1} (line {2}) when loaded through {3}. WPF does not use this definition.
data.comment: {0} = key, {1} = file that wins, {2} = line, {3} = App.xaml or window file

data.name: OptionsWarnOverriddenDescription
data.value: Shows a warning in the Error List for each resource that WPF never uses, because a dictionary that is merged later defines the same key.
